carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make People Want to Stand Closer

slides.name: Her
slides.copy: Crushed berries with violet and jasmine — playful enough to close the gap.

slides.name: Si
slides.copy: Blackcurrant and rose over vanilla — sweet, warm, hard not to lean toward.

slides.name: Fuel for Life Homme
slides.copy: Anise and grapefruit into warm woods — an easy, magnetic pull.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make Your Presence Known Before You Speak

slides.name: Man In Black
slides.copy: Rum and spice over leather and tonka — the room notices before you say a word.

slides.name: Made to Measure
slides.copy: Lavender and orange blossom over leather and amber — refined, deliberate, unmistakable.

slides.name: London for Men
slides.copy: Cinnamon and tobacco leaf into oakmoss and guaiac wood — warm authority, no effort shown.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Smell Like a Plot Twist

slides.name: Dirt
slides.copy: Literally the smell of turned earth — the plot twist nobody expects from a perfume.

slides.name: Sécrétions Magnifiques
slides.copy: Milk, seaweed, and iris pushed past comfortable — one of the most talked-about scents ever bottled.

slides.name: Anima Dulcis
slides.copy: Cocoa, cinnamon, and smoked chili — a dessert that turns into something else entirely.
